verdict.rationale: Google ships an official Agent SDK that exposes the same tools, agent loop, and context management that power Antigravity, programmable in Python. It lets developers build autonomous agents, layer custom Python callables, MCP servers and skills over built-in filesystem and terminal tools, and pass multimedia attachments. Missing for 10: SDKs in languages other than Python, in-depth API reference documentation beyond product-page claims, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
